Because large vans cannot enter Old Mardin's stepped stone alleys, transfers stop along Birinci Cadde where hotel porters meet guests for luggage handoff.

body.text: How far is MQM from Old Mardin's stone hotels (25 min) and Midyat (75 min)?

Located on Turgut Özal Avenue in Kızıltepe per [DHMİ Mardin Airport records](https://dhmi.gov.tr/Sayfalar/Havalimani/Mardin/IletisimBilgileri.aspx), [Mardin Prof. Dr. Aziz Sancar Airport (MQM)](https://dhmi.gov.tr/Sayfalar/Havalimani/Mardin/AnaSayfa.aspx) sits roughly 20 kilometers from Old Mardin's main street (Birinci Cadde), a 25-minute climb up the escarpment. Midyat lies approximately 75 kilometers east, requiring 75 to 85 minutes via the scenic Tur Abdin plateau road.

Traffic builds noticeably in New Mardin (Yenişehir) between 17:00 and 19:00 and on Birinci Cadde during busy spring and autumn weekends. If your flight lands in the late afternoon, expect the final three kilometers into the old quarter to move slowly as local minibuses and delivery vehicles share the single hilltop artery.

body.text: Why can large vans not enter Old Mardin's narrow stone streets?

Old Mardin is built across a steep limestone hillside connected by vaulted stone passages (abbaras) and stepped footpaths designed for foot traffic and pack animals rather than modern vehicles. Large Mercedes Sprinter minibuses and even standard touring vans cannot turn onto side lanes below or above Birinci Cadde without blocking traffic or scraping historic masonry.

Moreover, municipal rules restrict heavy tourist coaches from parking along Birinci Cadde during peak daytime hours. Smart transfer planning uses a standard sedan or compact Mercedes Vito for hotel drop-offs, timing arrival so the driver pauses briefly at the closest legal pullout while your hotel's reception staff coordinate the final walk.
How do boutique hotels handle luggage porters from the main street?

Most restored stone mansions and boutique hotels in Old Mardin arrange complimentary luggage porters or compact electric/motorized carts to meet guests directly on Birinci Cadde. Your airport driver calls the hotel desk 10 minutes before climbing into the old quarter so a staff member is waiting at the curb when you step out.

Never attempt to wheel heavy hard-shell suitcases down Old Mardin's steep stone stairways unassisted, especially after rain when polished limestone becomes slick. Packing slightly lighter—or using medium roller bags instead of oversized trunks—makes both the Old Mardin arrival and day trips to Midyat far easier.

items: Share your hotel's direct WhatsApp or reception phone number with your driver before leaving MQM.
Confirm whether your room sits above or below Birinci Cadde and how many steps separate the street from reception.
Wear grippy flat shoes on arrival day for the short stone walk from the drop-off point.
Schedule morning departures from Old Mardin at least 2 hours before MQM flights so porter pickup and uphill traffic never squeeze check-in.

body.text: What flights connect MQM to Istanbul and İzmir?

[Turkish Airlines](https://www.turkishairlines.com/en-tr/flights/flights-to-mardin/), Pegasus, AJet, and SunExpress connect Mardin Prof. Dr. Aziz Sancar Airport with Istanbul Airport (IST), Sabiha Gökçen (SAW), and Ankara (ESB) on daily schedules. Direct flights between MQM and [İzmir Adnan Menderes Airport (ADB)](https://www.google.com/travel/flights/flights-from-mardin-to-izmir.html?gl=TR&hl=en) operate on select days of the week (taking roughly 2 hours 5 minutes nonstop), with daily one-stop connections via Istanbul or Ankara.

Because Mardin's popularity peaks in April–May and September–November, nonstop seats to Istanbul and İzmir fill rapidly around national holidays and weekends. faq.q: Are taxis available outside Mardin Prof. Dr. Aziz Sancar Airport?
faq.a: Yes, official airport taxis line up outside the MQM arrivals door for every scheduled flight. For direct trips to Old Mardin hotels, confirm your drop-off landmark on Birinci Cadde before setting off.

faq.q: Is there a Havaş shuttle from MQM to Old Mardin?
faq.a: Airport shuttle buses run from MQM to Kızıltepe and New Mardin (Yenişehir), with connections up to Old Mardin. Travelers with suitcases generally prefer a taxi or pre-booked car to avoid changing vehicles on the hill.

faq.q: Should I stay in Old Mardin or New Mardin?
faq.a: Old Mardin places you inside historic stone architecture overlooking the Mesopotamian plain, while New Mardin offers flat streets, modern chain hotels, and easier parking for business travelers or guests with mobility limits.

faq.q: Can you visit Dara Ancient City and Deyrulzafaran Monastery straight from MQM?
faq.a: Yes. Both sites lie east of the airport along the plain road, making them easy to visit with a private driver before checking into Old Mardin or on your final day before an evening flight.

faq.q: How far is Diyarbakır Airport (DIY) if MQM flights are sold out?
faq.a: Diyarbakır Airport sits roughly 95 kilometers north of Mardin—about 85 to 95 minutes by divided highway. It serves as a practical backup hub with higher daily flight frequency to Istanbul and Ankara.

faq.q: Is Old Mardin accessible for travelers with limited mobility?
faq.a: Parts of Birinci Cadde are relatively level, but most historic mansions involve stone stairs. Travelers who prefer step-free access should request a street-level room on Birinci Cadde or stay in New Mardin.
